description: Repair needed: pull-sync converged development-vessel to 82bacc410e with NO test gate — the per-tick budget (420s) was exhausted after 494s, so the suite never ran. This is not a passing gate, it is an absent one, and it is absent precisely when a tick is slow, which is when convergence is riskiest. Repair the capability by raising the budget, sharding the gate across ticks, or running the suite before the tick's other work.
